svg.title: ResUNet3D five-stage residual U-Net architecture
svg.desc: A hand-authored architecture map for the native 3-D ResUNet3D baseline. The verified default trace starts with a four-channel 96-cubed MRI patch, passes through five encoder stages with widths 32, 64, 128, 256, and 512, then returns through four decoder stages and a one-by-one-by-one head to three raw ET, TC, and WT logits at the original spatial size. Four explicit skip routes connect encoder stages one through four to decoder stages dec0 through dec3. Insets show the residual block operations, decoder shape alignment, phased training contract, and optional timm ResNet-18 encoder transfer. The separate CNN denoising encoder_best.pth artifact is marked as outside this ResUNet3D transfer route.
